releaseNotes: 6D6X6 2.5.75.0: adds automatic DXGI cursor mode. On Windows 11, pointer-only Desktop Duplication events no longer enter the H.264 queue when the hardware cursor is carried separately; cursor shape and position use the low-latency WebRTC data channel instead. When Windows already embeds the cursor in the desktop surface, Host keeps it in video and disables synthetic drawing. H.264 profile 42C032, audio, input, file transfer and network routing remain unchanged.
